body:
Fixes #23.
Fixes #21.

Loading thousands of gallery cards kept a backdrop filter on every card, adding avoidable rendering pressure behind the fixed header. Offscreen cards, repositories and posts now disable their filters through one shared viewport observer; visible panels retain their selected skin. The redundant gallery Share icon is removed, leaving the full-card editor link.

The editor now starts with bend **0**, keeps full and partial self-loops balanced, and offers independent signed loop shaping. Displaced endpoint and middle markers follow arc length and the local tangent. Four optional gaps per link inherit global settings when blank, survive URL sharing/export and saved looks, and participate in the experimental overlap solver. Applying the solver preserves its preview exactly. Legacy gallery, rain and theory geometry remains covered by stored hashes.

The [case study](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-23-729a1009db7c/docs/case-studies/issue-23/README.md) maps every requirement to its cause, implementation and evidence, including the complete audit of #21, archived reports/logs, research, alternatives and default-off diagnostics. The supplied Safari screenshots document the intermittent blink. Native display captures now verify bounded filter counts and visible blur in Chromium/Firefox on Linux and WebKit on macOS at the full reported load. The exact original Safari GPU failure remains unisolated; optional diagnostics are available for recurrence. A separately reproduced Firefox screenshot defect is reported upstream with a minimal example and workaround: [microsoft/playwright#43646](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43646).

### Reproduction and regression checks

On the original code, open `/network/?code=00000000` to see bent free links, or `/network/?code=11&startOffset=12&endOffset=12` to see displaced markers leave the loop. The old gallery also exposes two links per card and retains 4,131 filters after loading 4,131 cards. Failing geometry and DOM tests and production screenshots were captured before the fix.

- Geometry, curve, solver and DOM regressions cover neutral defaults, signed ranges, native curve placement, individual/inherited gaps, URL round-trips, exact applied previews, list-observer cleanup and a dense 24-link solver scaling regression.
- All four network browser suites run in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, including real image downloads, source colors, supplied #21 URLs, history, mobile editing and actual composited header blur.
- All three engines pass the exact **4,131-card** load, repeated scrolling and actual display-pixel blur checks in all three skins, with **55–176 active card filters** and zero page errors. A separate audit passes all ten HTML entries across skins, themes, languages and desktop/mobile widths (**240 combinations**).
- **710 unit tests**, lint/format/line limits/secrets, dependency audit, production build and **120 CV PDFs** pass locally; detailed results are in [VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-23-729a1009db7c/docs/case-studies/issue-23/VALIDATION.md).

Final head CI is green: [run 40276708061](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/actions/runs/40276708061) at `cf1e6ec`, including all browser suites, 710 unit tests, builds and 120 PDFs. The complete source-validation evidence from [run 40275956453](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/actions/runs/40275956453) at `0bc96b4` is archived in the case study; the final commit adds only that evidence. `main` is already included, and the working tree is clean.

### Visual comparison

Neutral free links, before and after:

![Before: nonzero default bend](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-23-729a1009db7c/docs/case-studies/issue-23/screenshots/chromium-before-free.png?raw=true)
![After: straight free links](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-23-729a1009db7c/docs/case-studies/issue-23/screenshots/chromium-after-free.png?raw=true)

Displaced loop markers, before and after:

![Before: markers leave the curve](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-23-729a1009db7c/docs/case-studies/issue-23/screenshots/chromium-before-markers.png?raw=true)
![After: markers follow the curve](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-23-729a1009db7c/docs/case-studies/issue-23/screenshots/chromium-after-markers.png?raw=true)

Gallery card, before and after:

![Before: redundant Share icon](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-23-729a1009db7c/docs/case-studies/issue-23/screenshots/chromium-before-card.png?raw=true)
![After: one full-card editor link](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-23-729a1009db7c/docs/case-studies/issue-23/screenshots/chromium-after-card.png?raw=true)

Large-gallery render before and after (4,131 loaded cards; exact Safari blinking is retained in the original report images linked from the case study):

![Before: filters retained by every card](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-23-729a1009db7c/docs/case-studies/issue-23/screenshots/chromium-before-gallery.png?raw=true)
![After: visible cards and blurred header](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-23-729a1009db7c/docs/case-studies/issue-23/screenshots/chromium-after-gallery-glass.png?raw=true)

Final mobile editor with per-link gaps:

![Mobile gap controls, Russian](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-23-729a1009db7c/docs/case-studies/issue-23/screenshots/mobile-gaps.png?raw=true)

Native macOS WebKit after loading 4,131 cards (actual display capture):

![Final macOS WebKit gallery with visible header blur](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-23-729a1009db7c/docs/case-studies/issue-23/ci-evidence/40275956453/webkit/screenshots/issue23/webkit-after-gallery-glass-display.png?raw=true)
